name: Default
shortDescription: Single sign-on identity and access management server for OpenID Connect and OAuth 2, with passkeys and MFA, backed by an embedded Hiqlite database.

alerts.message: Sign in at /auth/v1/account with the BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL and BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD_PLAIN values from the environment and change the password right away. They only apply to the very first start.

No SMTP server is configured, so Rauthy cannot send password reset or new user emails. To enable them, add SMTP_URL, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD and SMTP_FROM (plus SMTP_TLS_MODE=starttls for port 587) to the rauthy service in docker-compose.yml and redeploy. Never set SMTP_URL to an empty or unreachable server: Rauthy stops on startup when it cannot connect.
